perspective:
**Angela Hwang’s available information:**

- She knows she and Kevin Flores have been close friends since high school and confide in each other.
- She knows Kevin is a construction worker and has noticed he seems unhappy with his job.
- She invited Kevin to coffee. At that meeting, Kevin told her he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions. He said he had thought about changing jobs/careers but did not know where to start and felt overwhelmed. Angela offered to look into options with him; he agreed and thanked her.
- Later, Angela found job openings and a career counseling service and told Kevin. Kevin thanked her and said he had been thinking a lot; he was interested in something more creative, possibly design or architecture. Angela encouraged him to check the resources; he said he would.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant, so she arranged a meeting with a career coach and told him. Kevin said she did not have to, appreciated it, but was unsure if he was ready. Angela encouraged him, saying the coach could help him make a plan and gain confidence. Kevin agreed to give it a shot.
- Angela believed Kevin was making progress, so she checked in. Kevin told her the career coach had been helpful, he had started online courses in design, and he felt more confident. Angela said she was proud and offered more help; Kevin said her support was enough and he would ask if he needed anything.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career, so she organized a small celebration party and told him. Kevin thanked her, said he was grateful, and said he could not have done it without her. Angela said he did the hard work and she was glad to support him.
- Angela does not have access to Kevin’s unspoken thoughts, private information, or events she did not personally observe or hear about from him.
